bus_stop: a rectangular traffic sign, typically blue with a white bus symbol or the text 'BUS STOP', indicating a designated area for buses to stop
do_not_enter: a circular traffic sign with a red border and a white background, featuring a red horizontal bar across the center (often with the text 'DO NOT ENTER' or a left-pointing arrow)
do_not_stop: a rectangular traffic sign with a red border and a red circle containing a cross inside, or text indicating that stopping is prohibited
do_not_turn_l: a square traffic sign with a white background and a black left-pointing arrow, crossed by a red diagonal slash
do_not_turn_r: a square traffic sign with a white background and a black right-pointing arrow, crossed by a red diagonal slash
do_not_u_turn: a square traffic sign with a white background and a black U-shaped arrow, crossed by a red diagonal slash
enter_left_lane: a rectangular traffic sign, typically white with black text or arrows, instructing drivers to enter the left lane
green_light: a traffic signal housing containing a circular light that is illuminated green, indicating permission to proceed
left_right_lane: a rectangular traffic sign, typically white with black text or arrows, indicating that the lane allows traffic to go in both left and right directions
no_parking: a circular traffic sign with a blue background and a red border, featuring a red 'P' crossed by a red diagonal slash
parking: a rectangular traffic sign, typically white with black text or a 'P' symbol, indicating a designated parking area
ped_crossing: a rectangular traffic sign, typically white with a black symbol of a pedestrian walking, indicating a pedestrian crossing
ped_zebra_cross: a rectangular traffic sign, typically white with a black symbol of a pedestrian walking on zebra stripes, indicating a zebra crossing
railway_crossing: a rectangular traffic sign, typically white with a black symbol of a train or a crossbuck (X shape), indicating a railway crossing
red_light: a traffic signal housing containing a circular light that is illuminated red, indicating a stop
stop: an octagonal traffic sign with a red border and white background, featuring the word 'STOP' in black capital letters
t_intersection_l: a square traffic sign with a white background and a black T-shaped symbol with the vertical bar pointing to the left, indicating a T-intersection where the road ends and turns left
traffic_light: a vertical pole-mounted housing containing multiple circular lights (red, yellow, green) used to control traffic flow
u_turn: a square traffic sign with a white background and a black U-shaped arrow, indicating permission to make a U-turn
warning: a diamond-shaped traffic sign with a yellow or orange background and a black symbol, indicating a potential hazard ahead
yellow_light: a traffic signal housing containing a circular light that is illuminated yellow or amber, indicating caution or preparation to stop
